title: TWSA reconstruction in all basins
caption: Held-out 2016–2023 only. Cyan monthly pairs; pink OLS descriptive fit and calendar-year bootstrap 95% band (399 replicates); grey identity. R, RMSE and NSE evaluate predictions directly, not the fitted line. The target is a naturalized model, not independent observed storage.

title: GWSA reconstruction in all basins
caption: Held-out 2016–2023 only. Cyan monthly pairs; pink OLS descriptive fit and calendar-year bootstrap 95% band (399 replicates); grey identity. R, RMSE and NSE evaluate predictions directly, not the fitted line. The target is a naturalized model, not independent observed storage.

title: Matched land storage benchmark
caption: Soil, canopy and snow only, April 2002–December 2023 available pairs. GLDAS excludes groundwater and open surface water. Cross-model agreement is not human-component validation; shared climate inputs and the GWS subtraction create dependence. Regression is descriptive.

title: Rainfall and storage seasonality
caption: Native precipitation distributions by calendar month, 2003–2023 (boxes: quartiles; whiskers: 1.5 IQR; outliers suppressed). Pink mean observed TWSA and interannual interquartile band on right axis. Distribution spread is not confidence in the mean. Missing GRACE months are retained.

title: Annual climate and residual variability
caption: Matched available months within each year; minimum eight. Mean absolute deviation is centred on the corresponding series mean. Ratios do not add to one and may exceed one because components covary. These are variability diagnostics, not causal climate/human percentages; monthly samples are not uncertainty replicates.

title: Storage histories and period benchmarks
caption: National overview. GLDAS is partial land storage, not total TWSA. RMSE bars use distinct explicit targets, so their heights do not rank competing models. Emulator periods 2003–2009, 2010–2015 and 2016–2023 respectively overlap training, validation and held-out testing; only the final period is a test.

title: ENSO associations across Thailand
caption: Prespecified six-month ENSO lead. Partial Pearson correlations remove calendar month, linear trend and contemporaneous DMI on paired months, 2003–2023. Dots indicate FDR q<0.05 from whole-year circular rotations. All five candidate lags and both ENSO indices are retained in CSV; no best-lag significance claim. Basins share GRACE support.

title: ENSO and derived groundwater storage
caption: As the TWSA spatial diagnostic, with derived GWSA. Association can reflect recharge, compartment errors and management responses; it does not identify groundwater pumping. The finite rotation p value has resolution 1/21; this conservative screen has low power after multiple comparisons.

title: National lag and index sensitivity
caption: Calendar season, trend and DMI controlled. ONI and historical RONI v5 are frozen at acquisition; RONI v6 is operational in 2026, whereas v5 is deliberately retained here for index-version comparability. The five candidate lags are reported together. Correlation is association, not climate causation or evidence of human-only residuals.

title: Storage during ENSO phases
caption: Monthly means after calendar-season and linear-trend removal, 2003–2023. ONI episodes require five consecutive overlapping seasons at ±0.5 C, classified on provider-table 0.1 C precision. Numbers are available months, not independent events. Equal-episode estimates and episode-bootstrap intervals are supplied separately in CSV; phase bars are descriptive and do not remove IOD.

title: Climate reconstruction by ENSO phase
caption: Frozen climate ensemble evaluated in 2016–2023, with the naturalized parent as target. Phase subsets differ in sample size and target variance; do not compare phase NSE without these counts. No phase-specific refitting or ENSO predictor was introduced after examining test performance.

title: Spatial GRACE storage trends and Mann Kendall evidence
caption: Basin-average CSR TWSA and compartment-derived GWSA; seasonal Sen slopes and basin FDR q. q colours saturate at 0.10. Seasonal MK does not correct serial dependence; slope intervals are supplied in the numerical tables. All basins retain the CSR small-support caution.

title: Observed storage time series for all 22 basins
caption: Monthly CSR TWSA and full-compartment GWSA, in mm. Mission gaps remain missing and GWSA ends in September 2023. Basin codes identify every subplot; full names are in Appendix A.

title: Spatial naturalized storage and climate reconstruction
caption: Calendar-month fixed-effect slopes. C is the naturalized WaterGAP baseline used in R=O−C; the statistical emulator reconstructs its parent-model target on its retained verification footprint. Emulator slopes use CSR-available dates through 2023, not a fit to GRACE. These columns are related model estimates, not independent observations.

title: TWSA climate reconstruction for all 22 basins
caption: Naturalized parent-model target and frozen meteorological ensemble reconstruction. Green shading identifies the held-out 2016–2023 period; earlier values are training or validation context. The emulator targets a hydrological model, not independently observed storage.

title: GWSA climate reconstruction for all 22 basins
caption: Naturalized parent-model target and frozen meteorological ensemble reconstruction. Green shading identifies the held-out 2016–2023 period; earlier values are training or validation context. The emulator targets a hydrological model, not independently observed storage.

title: Spatial residual and modeled human perturbation
caption: Calendar-month fixed-effect slopes on the same observation-valid support. R includes the represented direct-human perturbation H and discrepancy E. Each panel has its own labelled scale to keep small H visible; compare numerical scales before comparing colours. These slopes are not additive Sen-slope fractions.

title: TWSA residual histories for all 22 basins
caption: Observed-minus-naturalized residual R and paired modeled human perturbation H. Missing observed months are retained. R−H is unresolved observation–historical-model discrepancy; a negative R is not automatically measured pumping.

title: GWSA residual histories for all 22 basins
caption: Observed-minus-naturalized residual R and paired modeled human perturbation H. Missing observed months are retained. R−H is unresolved observation–historical-model discrepancy; a negative R is not automatically measured pumping.

title: Spatial GLDAS matched compartment comparison
caption: Soil + canopy + snow only, common valid-cell support and common 2004–2009 reference. The record extends through December 2023. Each panel has a labelled scale; groundwater and surface water are excluded. This is a cross-model benchmark, not independent full-TWS or residual validation.

title: Matched GLDAS time series for all 22 basins
caption: Matched soil + canopy + snow anomalies in mm. GLDAS and WaterGAP share climatic influences. Agreement evaluates land-component consistency; it cannot validate groundwater or the entire human residual.

title: Spatial GLDAS and residual comparisons
caption: Top: slopes of separately standardized series on identical joint months; scale saturates at ±0.2 SD/year. Bottom: descriptive correlations, with the matched land-component correlation for context. GLDAS land storage and residual storage are different quantities. No cross-compartment NSE, RMSE or claim of human validation is made. GLDAS also contributes to GWS subtraction.

title: GLDAS and residual histories for all 22 basins
caption: Each variable is standardized on the same jointly observed months within each basin. Different compartments are compared in timing and shape, not treated as equivalent water volumes. Missing months remain gaps. This is a dependence diagnostic, not independent anthropogenic validation.

title: Spatial climate model evaluation
caption: Frozen ensemble verification against naturalized parent storage during 2016–2023. Maps distinguish raw NSE, training-climatology-anomaly NSE and RMSE; NSE colours saturate below −1. High seasonal skill is not observational validation of a natural counterfactual.

title: Climate model evaluation through time
caption: Metrics are calculated separately for each held-out year using the training-climatology anomaly definition. Shading is spatial interquartile variation, not a confidence interval. Annual scores use 12 modeled months and may be unstable when anomaly variance is small; pooled 96-month results remain primary.

title: Spatial evaluation of residual agreement with groundwater
caption: Observed annual heads compared separately with TWS and GWS residuals. Hatching marks unavailable correlations or fewer than eight matched years. Support maps expose small samples. Heads and equivalent water depth are not commensurate volumes, so head–storage NSE and RMSE are not calculated. Raw association is indirect groundwater evidence for TWS, not total-human validation.

title: Annual groundwater and residual histories for all 22 basins
caption: Co-located wells are first grouped by station, then averaged. Displayed series are standardized on their joint annual support; they are not water-volume conversions. Annual storage requires at least eight valid months and complete year endpoints. Gaps remain missing. Numerical correlation maps use each target’s own longest eligible support, whereas this three-line display uses joint support.

title: Spatial independent reservoir component evidence
caption: MSEA-Res Level-1 scene estimates, fixed pre-2004 populations and matched-month season/trend-adjusted correlations. Grey hatching means unavailable evidence, not zero effect. Reservoir correlations with GWS residuals are dependence diagnostics and do not directly validate groundwater. No naturalized observed reservoir counterfactual is available.

title: Residual validation metrics and network support through time
caption: National rolling head–residual correlations require at least six observed annual pairs in an eight-calendar-year window. Windows overlap and are descriptive, not independent tests or a model-selection device. Bars show represented coordinate-station groups; station counts are not the temporal correlation sample size. Basin-specific rolling metrics accompany the figure.

title: Mean forcing and supporting data 1
caption: Available-month means within 2003–2023; values describe basin averages, not native pixel trends. Native precipitation and PET drive the climate reconstruction; CHIRPS is alternative rainfall. Actual ET, soil moisture and surface temperature provide context. Unequal product coverage is retained; no significance or causal attribution is implied.

title: Mean forcing and supporting data 2
caption: Available-month means within 2003–2023; values describe basin averages, not native pixel trends. Native precipitation and PET drive the climate reconstruction; CHIRPS is alternative rainfall. Actual ET, soil moisture and surface temperature provide context. Unequal product coverage is retained; no significance or causal attribution is implied.

title: Native precipitation for all basins
caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. These are actual meteorological climate-model inputs.

title: Native potential ET for all basins
caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. These are actual meteorological climate-model inputs.

title: CHIRPS precipitation for all basins
caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. CHIRPS is used as alternative rainfall in the forcing test.

title: GLEAM actual ET and MODIS actual ET for all basins
caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. These datasets provide supporting context; they are not additional predictors in the primary climate reconstruction.

title: ESA CCI surface moisture and ESA CCI root zone moisture for all basins
caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. These datasets provide supporting context; they are not additional predictors in the primary climate reconstruction.

caption: Monthly basin means during 2003–2023, in the stated physical units. Every basin is shown; unavailable months remain gaps. These datasets provide supporting context; they are not additional predictors in the primary climate reconstruction.

title: Thailand principal basins
caption: The 22 ONWR principal basins. Administrative reporting polygons do not create independent GRACE resolution.

title: Processing-chain sensitivity
caption: Common-date comparison of CSR and COST-G/G3P chains. Basin trend-ranking agreement is weak: Spearman 0.138 for TWSA and 0.027 for GWSA. Gravity and compartment processing differ, so groundwater contrasts cannot be attributed solely to GRACE.

title: Climate memory ablation
caption: Controlled Ridge experiment: current weather compared with weather-memory predictors; same training, validation and test splits. National test anomaly NSE rises from 0.283 to 0.890 for TWSA and 0.039 to 0.723 for GWSA.

title: National precipitation and potential ET
caption: Native rainfall and PET drive the emulator. CHIRPS is independent alternative rainfall; native P/PET monthly totals use actual calendar month lengths.

title: Independent reservoir component evidence
caption: Scene-supported national reservoir and TWS residual anomalies after removing season and trend, then standardizing. Points retain missing scene support; no gap interpolation. r = 0.439 across 73 paired months; year-cluster interval 0.188–0.665.
